section_1_general_description.intended_purpose: Deterministic interception, pre-dispatch transactional reservation (TCC), uncertain-outcome wire latching (HTTP 504 / TCP RST), and continuous cryptographic receipt emission for autonomous AI tool dispatches.
section_1_general_description.target_market_classification: Annex III Standalone High-Risk & Annex I Embedded High-Risk Addendum
section_1_general_description.deployer_provider_demarcation: AEIB operates as a deployer-configured runtime gate. The deployer retains legal responsibility for institutional quality management, human staffing, and target systems.

section_2_component_integration_and_hard.zero_egress_agent_boundary: Agent domain configured with network_mode: 'none'; communicates via local socket.
section_2_component_integration_and_hard.mcp_tool_provenance_pinning: Tool descriptors pinned via SHA-256 and verified prior to session registration.

section_3_development_methods_and_comput.five_term_pre_dispatch_predicate: GrantValid and PolicyEpochFresh and SourceEpochFresh and CAIDMatch and TicketUnburned
section_3_development_methods_and_comput.tcc_escrow_engine: SQLite WAL with BEGIN IMMEDIATE serialized transactions

section_4_monitoring_logging_and_auditin.article_12_wire_level_logging: Every external dispatch intent and resulting outcome is committed to an append-only hash-chained ledger prior to and immediately following socket I/O.
section_4_monitoring_logging_and_auditin.ietf_scitt_transparency: RFC 9942 COSE receipts with RFC 9162 SHA-256 Merkle inclusion proofs.

hazard_log.title: Layer 7 Transport Ambiguity & Duplicate Consequential Mutation
hazard_log.clinical_or_financial_risk: Network timeout (HTTP 504) or TCP reset causes unhedged agent retry, executing duplicate patient medication disbursement, double financial transfer, or redundant physical actuator cycle.
hazard_log.aeib_mitigation_control: Station 3 Wire Latch traps state to EFFECT_INDETERMINATE (retry_safe: false). Automated retries blocked; single out-of-band probe (ProbeBudget: 1) verifies downstream state.

hazard_log.title: Concurrent Multi-Agent Budget & Resource Overrun
hazard_log.clinical_or_financial_risk: Concurrent subagents read unreserved balance simultaneously and execute parallel dispatches, overrunning institutional budget ceilings or physical medication reservoirs.
hazard_log.aeib_mitigation_control: Pre-socket TCC (Try-Confirm-Cancel) atomic reservation in SQLite WAL with BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Subagents cannot dispatch until budget is locked; excess requests rejected fail-closed.

hazard_log.title: Memory Poisoning & Prompt Injection Parameter Tampering (AT57)
hazard_log.clinical_or_financial_risk: Adversary manipulates working memory or RAG context to alter destination IBAN, clinical dosage value, or actuator threshold without operator consent.
hazard_log.aeib_mitigation_control: Station 1 Context Integrity Gate evaluates candidate action CAID against ingestion-time commitment manifest. Tampered parameters trigger HALT_CONTEXT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE (0 socket bytes emitted).

hazard_log.title: Audit Log Tampering & Forensic Repudiation
hazard_log.clinical_or_financial_risk: Malicious insider or compromised operating system alters local audit rows to conceal fraudulent transactions or lethal clinical dosage modifications.
hazard_log.aeib_mitigation_control: RFC 8785 JCS + Ed25519 hash-chained Continuity Receipts registered into RFC 9942 / RFC 9943 SCITT Merkle tree transparent statements. Any in-place bit flip triggers InvalidSignature.

section_6_human_oversight_and_fail_close.article_14_decoupled_oversight: Safety policy decoupled from model weights; enforced at pre-socket gate. Prohibition of [APPROVE OVERRIDE] without authenticated target evidence.
section_6_human_oversight_and_fail_close.step_up_dual_control: RFC 9470 Step-Up Dual Control token required for high-consequence dispatches.
